text:
Situation: Dexamethasone sodium phosphate has been on FDA's drug shortage list since 2019-02-08 and remains Current as of 2026-10-21. Affected companies listed by FDA include Eugia US LLC, Fresenius Kabi USA LLC, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., Mylan Institutional, and Somerset Therapeutics LLC. Corvale East holds 5.5 days of 1 mg tablets, 6.3 days of 10 mg/mL 1 mL vials, and 7.8 days of 4 mg/mL 5 mL vials. Corvale General holds 25.9 days of 1 mg tablets, 15.3 days of 10 mg/mL 1 mL vials, 19 days of 4 mg/mL 5 mL vials, and 14.5 days of an additional 4 mg/mL presentation.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1074573 at Eugia Pharma Specialities Limited ended 2018-12-14 with a VAI classification, 56 days before the shortage posting. Inspection 1228546 ended 2024-02-02 with an OAI classification. Inspection 1301166 ended 2026-02-06 with an OAI classification. FDA issued a Warning Letter to Eugia Pharma Specialities Limited on 2024-08-15. FDA's related information for the Eugia US LLC listing notes to check wholesalers for inventory.

Our position: Internal transfers can bridge Corvale East's immediate gaps while maintaining at least two weeks of supply at Corvale General. External purchases from suppliers not on the FDA shortage list are available but require verification of manufacturing site reliability.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 56 tablets of dexamethasone 1 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director.
2. Transfer 16 vials of dexamethasone sodium phosphate 10 mg/mL 1 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director.
3. Transfer 63 vials of dexamethasone sodium phosphate 4 mg/mL 5 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director.
4. Contact wholesalers for available inventory per FDA's related information — approved by buyer.
5. Evaluate purchase from Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC and Armas Pharmaceuticals after confirming manufacturing site quality — approved by buyer and pharmacy director.

Not recommended: Initiate any clinical protocol changes or alternative dosing strategies; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the P&T committee.
